description: This file contains the implementation of the Zipf distribution class within the Apache Commons Math library. It defines the distribution's parameters, probability functions, cumulative functions, statistical measures, and support bounds.

classes.name: ZipfDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the Zipf distribution, modeling a discrete probability distribution with power-law characteristics over a finite set of elements.

methods.name: getNumberOfElements
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements (size of the support).

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability of a specific value x in the distribution.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the probability for a given value x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative probability up to a value x.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, calculated lazily.

methods.name: calculateNumericalMean
methods.description: Internal method to compute the mean based on harmonic numbers.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, calculated lazily.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Internal method to compute the variance based on harmonic numbers.

methods.name: generalizedHarmonic
methods.description: Computes the nth generalized harmonic number used in mean and variance calculations.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution support (always 1).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution support (number of elements).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is connected.
